protocol: per-update gradient variance at the initial policy, under the TRUE reward, 2 episodes averaged exactly as the trainer forms an update; baselines for Q / V / row-wise Delta come from the fitted table at each label budget; 16 train instances x 1200 batches (scratchpad diag_update.py)

bias.protocol: E[g_hat].g/|g|^2 and |E[g_hat]-g|^2/|g|^2 at the initial policy, 3 instances x 8000 batches (scratchpad diag_bias.py); the 1e-4-level values are float32 accumulation, not real bias
